title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: search and query Dataverse business data with Business Applications in Work IQ
summary: Hold for corrections to the data-access description and automation gap. Dataverse permissions alone do not make every record available, Microsoft documents an API for app-setting overrides, and the solution-import rule requires Work IQ to be on in the destination environment.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls: automation absence; Open questions: API
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API for the app-level Copilot setting, so reading and changing it is done in the portal.
claims.quote: Creates or updates app/organization level override. ... SettingName ... Setting definition unique name (Required). ... Value ... Overridden value that needs to be set (Required).
claims.fix: Replace controls[2].api with kind 'rest', call 'POST /api/data/v9.2/SaveSettingValue', docs https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/reference/savesettingvalue. Add to its note: 'The request body uses SettingName m365copilotmodelappenabled, Value for the override, and AppUniqueName for the target app; publish the app for setting changes to take effect.' The setting name is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/user/use-business-apps-work-iq and generic setting automation at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/model-driven-apps/clientapi/get-update-setting-value-using-code. Remove the app setting from the automation-absence sentence and narrow the final open question to the tenant and Work IQ environment switches.
